strategies.label: C-S-wheat or oats + cover
strategies.why: Adds to the current rotation: a winter cereal rye cover keeps living roots over winter; a small grain adds a third crop family that breaks corn-soybean pest cycles.

Reference ET and crop coefficients follow FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998).
Soil available water capacity and K factor from SSURGO (NRCS).
Field crop history from USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer.
